map.周期信号的基频为其周期的倒数。: The fundamental frequency of a periodic signal is the reciprocal of its period.
map.周期 20 ms 对应 50 Hz 基频。: A period of 20 ms corresponds to a 50 Hz fundamental.
map.周期信号周期 T 求基频 f0。: Find the fundamental f0 from period T of a periodic signal.
map.傅里叶级数展开的频率基准。: The frequency reference for Fourier series expansion.
map.谐波频率为基频整数倍。: Harmonic frequencies are integer multiples of the fundamental.
map.基频 f0 = 1 / 0.02 = 50 Hz；二次谐波 100Hz、三次 1: Fundamental f0 = 1 / 0.02 = 50 Hz; second harmonic 100Hz, third 150Hz.

map.基频与角频率关系？: What is the relation between fundamental and angular frequency?
